policy: Current facts only. Existing canonical model paths retained. Pin numbers, extra symbols and border decorations are independent. Wire routes and joined junctions are retained; crossings are rendered from wire paths. No archives or historical sidecars. Each page has an explicit raw page_type, transported without conversion as current_extensions.page_type. Its stable values are ald, cas, socket-listing, ros-listing, and miscellaneous. The finer page.kind is retained. Requested entry/footer presentation shifts apply only to page_type ald; CAS and all other page types retain their original UTF8 presentation.
